versions.subject: UNC2452 rules - GoldMax, Sibot, GoldFinder
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'Execute'
        - 'CreateObject'
        - 'RegRead'
        - 'window.close'
        - '\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
condition: selection
